comment: Pedra formal glue catalog. Production kernel is the source; Verus file is a twin; callers must invoke the kernel. twin_kind: close = entry (or token_src) is an exec fn in the twin; atom = smaller fn (atom) only; model = same name, stand-in domain (e.g. u64 for &[u8]). status=absent is a recorded gap (script exists, twin file does not). object: proof = machine-checked twin (exec==spec); campaign = named plant / seed replay (not forall traces). Default: id prefix in campaign_prefixes (l28_*) is campaign, else proof.

object_kinds.campaign: named plant / seed replay — not forall traces

atom_reason.why: RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (twenty-first if): the append-entries disposition — a conflicting entry truncates and reinstalls exactly when a different term already sits at that slot and the slot is above the commit index; a conflict at or below commit is refused, never rewritten (F16) — proven forall over (entry_index, entry_term, existing_term, commit_index, last_log_index) as ae_entry_action_truncate_and_install_iff_conflict_above_commit in Ae.lean; the raft trampoline (handle_append_entries/rpc_append_entries) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (thirteenth if): the AppendEntries ack disposition — an ack succeeds exactly when the log is clean, or it is dirty and the persist succeeded (a dirty log whose persist failed never acks ok, F48) — proven forall over (log_dirty, persist_ok) as ae_ack_success_ok_iff_clean_or_dirty_persisted in Ae.lean; the raft handlers (handle_append_entries / rpc_append_entries) match the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (eleventh if): the joint-election disposition — the joint election elects exactly when C-old has majority AND (no joint is pending, or C-new also has majority); one side alone never elects (F-L28/RFC-0064) — proven forall over (old_yes, old_n, new_yes : Option) as joint_election_ok_elects_iff_old_and_new_majority in Membership.lean, a direct iff consequence of the registered C1 close c1_joint_election; the store trampoline (election_has_joint_quorum) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (tenth if): the election-grant disposition — a vote granted by a node counts exactly when the node is in the voter id set, or it is in the pending old-or-new joint set (a node in neither set never grants, RFC-0114/0116) — proven forall over (in_ids, in_pending_old_or_new) as election_grant_from_counts_ok_iff_ids_or_pending in Membership.lean; the store trampoline (on_request_vote_reply) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (ninth if): the uncommitted-leave disposition — a leave finishes exactly when the leave entry is not in the log, or it is already committed (a leave still in the log and uncommitted never finishes, RFC-0122/0123) — proven forall over (leave_in_log, leave_committed) as queued_leave_finish_ok_iff_not_in_log_or_committed in Membership.lean; the store trampoline (finish_uncommitted_leave) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (twelfth if): the lease-liveness disposition — a lease is live exactly when it is zero (never expires) or the clock is still below the expiry (an expired lease is never live, F7/F56) — proven forall over (lease, now_ms) as lease_live_iff_zero_or_now_below in Lease.lean; the dcs command caller matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (fifth if): the commit-vs-revert disposition of a txn — an aborted status always reverts and never materialises (the abort fence wins) — proven forall over status_is_abort as txn_commit_action_reverts_iff_abort in Txn.lean; the store trampoline apply_txn_commit matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (seventh if): the txn-status-key disposition after revert — the fence key may be dropped only when every pair is gone AND the status was not abort (an abort fence survives a later TxnCommit replay) — proven forall over (status_is_abort, pairs_empty) as revert_clears_status_clears_iff_pairs_gone_and_live in Txn.lean; the store trampoline apply_txn_revert matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (fourth if): the revert restore disposition — a user key is restored to its prepare-time value exactly when a preimage record exists and records the key as present (a missing record is not absent; never a blind delete) — proven forall over (had_pre_record, pre_was_absent) as revert_user_action_restore_value_iff_record_and_present in Txn.lean; the store trampoline apply_txn_revert matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P1.5: the SI-hist repair fate is decided by the kernel — leave iff gen-0 preimage floor or already-matching tip, proven forall over (tip_gen, tip_matches) as si_hist_repair_plan_leave_iff_floor_or_match in Txn.lean; the store trampoline repair_si_hist_tip matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (third if): the SI-hist load merge disposition — a decoded hist merges only when its tip is not below the best-so-far tip, and a corrupt hist never evicts a good copy — proven forall over (decoded_ok, best_has_user, new_last, existing) as hist_load_fate_merge_new_iff_decoded_and_not_below in Txn.lean; the store trampoline load_si_from_disk matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (seventeenth if): the manifest-recovery disposition — recovery refuses to open exactly when the manifest observation is Corrupt, or it is Inventory while an SST listed in the manifest is missing on disk (an absent manifest rescans and installs; a complete inventory serves; damage or a missing file never serves, F196/G8) — proven forall over (obs, listed) as sst_recover_action_refuse_iff_corrupt_or_inventory_missing in Manifest.lean; the db trampoline (recover_ssts) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (nineteenth if): the reopen disposition — a WAL reopen serves all records exactly when the log carries no damage; any damage (truncated head, CRC mismatch, zero header, resync) is refused or served only as a reported prefix, never silently served whole, F170/F171/G8 — proven forall over (damage, point_in_time, escalated) as reopen_outcome_serve_all_iff_damage_none in Reopen.lean; the db trampoline (open_with_env) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (eighteenth if): the compaction-pick disposition — a max-level GC rewrite is chosen exactly when no level holds files while GC was requested and files already sit at the max level (a level holding files yields a Merge of it with its successor; without both flags the plan is NoOp, F177/F20) — proven forall over (lowest_level_with_files, files_at_max_level, gc_requested, max_level) as compact_pick_gc_rewrite_max_iff_none_and_gc_and_files_at_max in Compact.lean; the db trampoline (compact_with_ssts_only) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (sixteenth if): the point-version retention disposition — a point version is dropped exactly when a newer kept version exists AND it sits at or below the oldest snapshot (a version still visible to the oldest snapshot is never dropped, and a version with no newer kept copy is never dropped either, F177/F20) — proven forall over (this_seq, newer_kept_seq, oldest_snapshot) as point_version_fate_drop_iff_newer_kept_at_or_below_oldest_snapshot in Compact.lean; the merge trampoline (gc_snapshot_safe) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (second if): the apply-path Put record fate — hist persists iff the key is live (not reserved) and gen is above the gen-0 floor — proven forall over (is_reserved, si_gen) as apply_put_plan_hist_iff_live_and_gen_positive in StoreApply.lean; the store trampoline apply_range matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (eighth if): the durable-term disposition — the term is durably raised exactly when the incoming term is strictly newer AND the persist succeeded (a failed persist restores the old term, never keeps a raised one) — proven forall over (current_term, incoming_term, persist) as durable_term_if_newer_raised_iff_newer_and_persisted in Vote.lean; the store/raft trampolines match the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (twentieth if): the vlog-recovery disposition — recovery refuses to open exactly when the MANIFEST says the swing committed (use_new) while neither file is on disk: blob mode off, large values wanted, no primary, no new (inventing an empty primary would make every large value vanish, F51/G-swing) — proven forall over (blob_active, wants_large, primary_exists, use_new, new_exists) as vlog_recover_action_refuse_open_iff_wants_large_use_new_and_nothing_on_disk in VlogGc.lean; the db trampoline (open_with_env) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (fifteenth if): the blob-GC disposition — the GC rewrites a blob gen exactly when the gen is inactive AND still carries bytes (an active gen is never rewritten; an empty inactive gen has nothing to rewrite, F-active-gen) — proven forall over (is_active, bytes) as blob_gc_action_rewrite_iff_inactive_with_bytes in VlogGc.lean; the db trampoline (compact_blob_auto) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (sixth if): the range-vs-tx disposition — the majority must revert exactly when the TX failed AND the range committed (a failed committed TX never stays live on the majority) — proven forall over (range_committed, tx_failed) as tx_range_action_majority_reverts_iff_failed_and_committed in TxGlue.lean; the store trampoline tx_finish matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (fourteenth if): the planted-joint schedule disposition — a planted committed-joint schedule is ok exactly when the opt-in world emits it and the default world still omits it (the plant is visible only to the opted-in reader, RFC-0068) — proven forall over (opt_in_emits, default_omits) as plant_joint_schedule_ok_iff_opt_in_emits_and_default_omits in StoreMembership.lean; the world trampoline (run) matches the kernel decision

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (twenty-second if): the effective column-family encoding disposition — the effective encoding is empty exactly when the cf is default and default_raw strips it, or the else-branch kept an already-empty cf; any other cf passes through untouched (RFC-0150 P0; the Str equality is the Aeneas boundary, stated over its Result so a fail/div comparison never fakes an empty encoding) — proven forall over (cf, default_raw) as cf_encode_effective_empty_iff_default_raw_else_identity in Cf.lean; the cf trampoline matches the kernel decision

RFC-0188 P1.6 first atom: the data-fate rule 'a deletion never surfaces live' proven forall over range_hidden (visible_at_deletion_never_live, Merge.lean); registered as atom in scripts/ratchet/close_proofs.tsv

RFC-0191 P2.3 cadence (twenty-third if): the GC oldest-boundary disposition — the boundary is exactly the live pin when one exists; unpinned, it is the visible minimum of last and visible seq, so GC never advances past a pin nor past what is visible (RFC-0150 P2b/F20; the Ord.min is the Aeneas boundary, stated over its Result) — proven forall over (oldest_pin, last_seq, visible_seq, v) as gc_oldest_from_pin_value_iff_pin_or_unpinned_visible_min in Compact.lean; the db trampoline (compact_reclaim) matches the kernel decision
